memberReminders.question: Are you a member?

member.description: Automatic reminder 2 weeks before and 1 day before the Membership Meeting (and, on Hall Rental/Potluck forms, that requested event)

nonMember.description: No automatic 2-week / 1-day early reminders; existing behavior unchanged

memberReminders.storage: Saved on this phone in localStorage (reminderSignup, memberReminders schedule) and, on Hall Rental / Potluck email forms, included in the email to VFW7243@yahoo.com

memberReminders.scopeNote: General phone-modal schedule is scoped to Meeting-category/recurring membership events, matching the app's existing reminder system (not the 95 sports watch promos); Hall Rental and Potluck member signups schedule reminders for that specific requested event.
